newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine oilseed crush over 16 mln T-industry.
newsitem.headline: Argentine oilseed crush over 16 mln T-industry.

text.p: Argentina's 1996/97 oilseed crush should be over 16 million tonnes if rain falls promptly in growing areas, the Oilseeds and Protein Meals Chamber said Friday.
The chamber predicted a crop of more than 19.5 million tonnes of oilseeds if rains come.
Argentina's exports of oilseeds and subproducts totaled $5.1 billion in 1996. Exports of meals totaled almost 11 million tonnes, just below the world's biggest exporter, Brazil, the Chamber said.
